scope: Ordinary financial lifecycle extensions at five existing Ethereum protocol deployments; no new target/protocol/authority

additions.label: stader-ethx-manager deposit
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only; no persistent runtime identity, financial safety, liquidity, funding, execution success or complete workflow assurance. Exact grants, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

Referral string is event-only attribution after the existing native-ETH deposit; same caller funding, receiver, min/max, pause and ETHx conversion/minting. No caller-set minimum shares or deadline. Mutable staderConfig and token dependencies remain external.

additions.label: ankr-eth-global-pool stake
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only; no persistent runtime identity, financial safety, liquidity, funding, execution success or complete workflow assurance. Exact grants, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

stake is an alias of stakeAndClaimAethC. claimAETH/claimFETH consume only caller accrued shares; fETH uses the configured rebasing-token lock/unlock accounting. Unstake burns only caller shares (or unlocks caller fETH), applies protocol minimum, then enqueues a nonzero recipient; it is not immediate ETH settlement. For variants may choose recipient but never select another burn owner. Shares versus bonds conversions/rounding, configurable token/config/withdrawalPool dependencies, separate stake/claim/unstake pauses, queue funding and token permissions remain protocol prerequisites. restake is event-only native funding, not an admitted financial receipt operation.

additions.label: mantle-meth-staking unstakeRequest
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only; no persistent runtime identity, financial safety, liquidity, funding, execution success or complete workflow assurance. Exact grants, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

unstakeRequest locks caller mETH via preexisting allowance, converts to ETH using current rate, enforces uint128 amount/minimum ETH and creates a request for msg.sender. claimUnstakeRequest delegates fixed request ID and caller to configured manager; manager ownership/finalization/liquidity checks remain authoritative. A request is not immediate payout; no permit or validator authority is admitted.

additions.label: liquid-collective-river depositAndTransfer
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only; no persistent runtime identity, financial safety, liquidity, funding, execution success or complete workflow assurance. Exact grants, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

depositAndTransfer stakes caller ETH to a nonzero recipient under existing allowlist/slashing rules. requestRedeem transfers caller lsETH to the configured redeem manager and records caller/recipient after allowlist checks; it is a queued request, not immediate ETH. claimRedeemRequests forwards fixed uint32 request/event arrays to that configured manager, whose stored recipient, funding, status and compliance checks govern payout. No request ownership, allowlist or NFT authority is granted.

additions.description: Vesper vaETH Pool deposit source-qualified fixed ABI.
additions.label: vesper-vaeth deposit
warnings: Static source/ABI inventory only; no persistent runtime identity, financial safety, liquidity, funding, execution success or complete workflow assurance. Exact grants, pauses and independent controls remain mandatory.

Own vaETH VETH/VPool methods only: ERC20 deposit uses configured WETH allowance and native depositAndClaim wraps msg.value; all receipt shares belong to caller. Withdraw burns caller shares after strategy withdrawal; partial withdrawal recalculates proportional shares. withdrawETH variants temporarily unwrap WETH for native payout; other exits return configured token. AndClaim/whitelistedWithdraw call configured poolRewards.claimReward(caller), not arbitrary callbacks; the latter name adds no whitelist grant. Mutable strategy, poolRewards, fee/governance, pauses/shutdown, rounding and missing minimum-output/deadline remain risks. Official pool API lists vaETH prod/operative at capture, not a persistent live-funding or implementation guarantee.

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity 0.8.9;

/// @title Errors library
library Errors {
    string public constant INVALID_COLLATERAL_AMOUNT = "1"; // Collateral must be greater than 0 or > defined limit
    string public constant INVALID_SHARE_AMOUNT = "2"; // Share must be greater than 0
    string public constant INVALID_INPUT_LENGTH = "3"; // Input array length must be greater than 0
    string public constant INPUT_LENGTH_MISMATCH = "4"; // Input array length mismatch with another array length
    string public constant NOT_WHITELISTED_ADDRESS = "5"; // Caller is not whitelisted to withdraw without fee
    string public constant MULTI_TRANSFER_FAILED = "6"; // Multi transfer of tokens has failed
    string public constant FEE_COLLECTOR_NOT_SET = "7"; // Fee Collector is not set
    string public constant NOT_ALLOWED_TO_SWEEP = "8"; // Token is not allowed to sweep
    string public constant INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE = "9"; // Insufficient balance to performs operations to follow
    string public constant INPUT_ADDRESS_IS_ZERO = "10"; // Input address is zero
    string public constant FEE_LIMIT_REACHED = "11"; // Fee must be less than MAX_BPS
    string public constant ALREADY_INITIALIZED = "12"; // Data structure, contract, or logic already initialized and can not be called again
    string public constant ADD_IN_LIST_FAILED = "13"; // Cannot add address in address list
    string public constant REMOVE_FROM_LIST_FAILED = "14"; // Cannot remove address from address list
    string public constant STRATEGY_IS_ACTIVE = "15"; // Strategy is already active, an inactive strategy is required
    string public constant STRATEGY_IS_NOT_ACTIVE = "16"; // Strategy is not active, an active strategy is required
    string public constant INVALID_STRATEGY = "17"; // Given strategy is not a strategy of this pool
    string public constant DEBT_RATIO_LIMIT_REACHED = "18"; // Debt ratio limit reached. It must be less than MAX_BPS
    string public constant TOTAL_DEBT_IS_NOT_ZERO = "19"; // Strategy total debt must be 0
    string public constant LOSS_TOO_HIGH = "20"; // Strategy reported loss must be less than current debt
    string public constant INVALID_MAX_BORROW_LIMIT = "21"; // Max borrow limit is beyond range.
    string public constant MAX_LIMIT_LESS_THAN_MIN = "22"; // Max limit should be greater than min limit.
    string public constant INVALID_SLIPPAGE = "23"; // Slippage should be less than MAX_BPS
    string public constant WRONG_RECEIPT_TOKEN = "24"; // Wrong receipt token address
    string public constant AAVE_FLASH_LOAN_NOT_ACTIVE = "25"; // aave flash loan is not active
    string public constant DYDX_FLASH_LOAN_NOT_ACTIVE = "26"; // DYDX flash loan is not active
    string public constant INVALID_FLASH_LOAN = "27"; // invalid-flash-loan
    string public constant INVALID_INITIATOR = "28"; // "invalid-initiator"
    string public constant INCORRECT_WITHDRAW_AMOUNT = "29"; // withdrawn amount is not correct
    string public constant NO_MARKET_ID_FOUND = "30"; // dydx flash loan no marketId found for token
    string public constant SAME_AS_PREVIOUS = "31"; // Input should not be same as previous value.
    string public constant INVALID_INPUT = "32"; // Generic invalid input error code
}

exclusions: Vesper vUSDC full ABI already covers ordinary deposit/withdraw; additional methods are signatures, token authority/transfers, global strategy maintenance or administration.
Ankr restake emits only an event without accounting user receipt; operator/manual/bridge/validator/configuration methods remain excluded.
Stader internal reward receipts, batch validator deposits, ETH allocation and roles/configuration are not user deposit functions.
Mantle permit, validator deposits, keeper ETH allocation and role/configuration methods remain excluded.
River protocol-only ETH return/reporting, consensus-layer validator deposits, initialization, administration and token authority/transfers remain excluded.
